options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name of the <nav> (aria-label) and the drawer title, e.g. "Main". Must not be empty.

options.name: items
options.type: readonly SidebarItem[] (SidebarLink { type?: 'item'; id; label; href?; icon?; disabled? } | SidebarGroup { type: 'group'; id; label; icon?; items })
options.description: Navigation tree (at least one item; groups need at least one child). Ids are unique across the whole tree; labels are non-empty. Links without href render as buttons.

options.name: value
options.description: Active (current page) item id; must be a non-group item. Default: no active item.

options.name: collapsed
options.description: Icon rail: labels are visually hidden and shown as tooltips. Inline mode only; forced to false when collapsible is false.

options.name: expanded
options.default: the groups containing the active item
options.description: Expanded group ids. Every id must be a group id.

options.name: collapsible
options.description: Render the collapse (rail) toggle in the footer.

options.name: breakpoint
options.description: Integer 0..4096: viewport width in CSS px below which the sidebar becomes a modal drawer. 0 never switches.

options.name: direction
options.description: 'rtl' sets dir="rtl" on the <nav> and footer; tooltips and the drawer also follow an inherited rtl direction.

options.name: icons
options.type: Partial<{ group: IconRef; collapse: IconRef; expand: IconRef }>

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component.

properties.name: nav
properties.description: The <nav> landmark. It lives in the host inline and in the drawer body in drawer mode.

properties.name: collapsed
properties.description: Whether the icon rail is requested (applied inline only).

properties.name: expanded
properties.description: Expanded group ids, in tree order.

properties.name: isOpen
properties.description: Whether the drawer is open (always false inline).

methods.name: open
methods.description: Open the drawer; focus moves into it. No-op in inline mode.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close the drawer; focus returns to the element focused before open(). No-op when closed or inline.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Mark a non-group item active and expand its groups. No events; does not close the drawer. Throws SIDEBAR_OPTIONS for an unknown or group id.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge, validate, and apply options. Focus stays on the item with the same id. An active id missing from new items becomes null. No events.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, host classes, tooltips, the drawer, the media query listener, listeners, and the configuration subscription.

events.name: aui-navigate
events.description: The user activated an enabled item (unmodified primary click, Enter, or Space on a button). preventDefault stops link navigation, the active change, and the drawer close.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: The active item changed after an uncanceled aui-navigate. Not emitted when the active item is activated again.

events.name: aui-expanded-change
events.detail: { id: string; expanded: boolean; value: string[] }
events.description: The user toggled a group. value lists all expanded group ids in tree order.

events.name: aui-collapsed-change
events.description: The user activated the collapse toggle.

events.name: aui-mode-change
events.description: The viewport crossed the breakpoint after creation. The initial mode is not reported.

cssClasses.name: aui-sidebar--drawer
cssClasses.description: Drawer mode; the host is display:none.

cssClasses.name: aui-sidebar__item
cssClasses.description: Link, button, disabled link, or group button; data-id is the item id.

cssClasses.name: aui-sidebar__item--contains-active
cssClasses.description: Collapsed group that contains the active item.

cssClasses.name: aui-sidebar__icon | __icon--initial | __label | __chevron
cssClasses.description: Item parts; __icon--initial is the first-letter fallback shown only in the rail.

cssClasses.name: aui-sidebar__footer | __toggle
cssClasses.description: Footer and the collapse toggle button.
